name: Eastvale Gateway
summary: Eastvale Gateway is the premier shopping destination in Eastvale, featuring major anchors like Best Buy and Dick's Sporting Goods alongside popular dining options including Buffalo Wild Wings, Chipotle, and the new Philz Coffee. This community-centered shopping center also houses essential services, the City of Eastvale offices, and a diverse mix of retailers serving the growing suburban population.
demographics: Eastvale Gateway serves a growing suburban family demographic in one of California's newest cities, attracting middle to upper-middle income households with children. The trade area draws young professionals and families, typically aged 25-54, with household incomes ranging from $80,000 to $150,000+, reflecting Eastvale's status as a master-planned community. Shoppers here prioritize convenience and value, seeking one-stop shopping for everyday needs, family dining, and essential services, with strong weekday evening and weekend traffic patterns typical of bedroom communities in the Inland Empire.
description: Eastvale Gateway stands as the premier shopping destination in Eastvale, California, serving as the commercial heart of this rapidly growing master-planned community in Riverside County. This sizable open-air shopping center brings together an impressive mix of national retailers, dining establishments, essential services, and entertainment options all conveniently located along Limonite Avenue. Major anchors include Best Buy and Dick's Sporting Goods, complemented by popular retailers like Bath & Body Works, Famous Footwear, and Carter's Babies and Kids, providing comprehensive shopping options for the community's family-oriented demographic. The center's diverse dining scene features crowd favorites such as Applebee's, Buffalo Wild Wings, Chipotle, Blaze Pizza, and Georgia's Restaurant, alongside local gems like EastBrew Cafe and Bakery, with recent additions including the highly anticipated Philz Coffee. Beyond retail and dining, Eastvale Gateway serves as a true community hub, housing the City of Eastvale offices, banking services from Chase and Bank of America, medical facilities including Eastvale Medical Group, and personal care services like European Wax Center, DryBar, and the newly opened LaserAway, making it an indispensable one-stop destination for residents of Eastvale and surrounding Inland Empire communities.
